The Company installed 20 TPH capacity biomass boiler to meet the thermal energy requirement of its new Herbicide plant and existing DDA plant.

The biomass boiler has replaced approximately 4,500 MT of coal utilisation so far in the Financial Year 2022-23. This has helped reduced GHG emissions by ~9,000 MT CO2 which is equivalent to carbon sequestered by ~10,700 acres of forests in a year. It has improved the Company’s renewable energy portfolio from 0% to 35%.
